wifiDemo: Demo mode — there is no physical hub.
wifiAddress: The app is working with the hub at {address}.
wifiHint: You can change the Wi-Fi network later in Settings → Connection. If the hub gets a new IP, reconnect from the start screen (or scan the QR code after saving Wi-Fi).
timeSyncRequested: Time sync requested — wait a few seconds.
tariffBody: Enter the price per kWh as on your bill — the hub counts money by it. Levies and more zones are on the “Tariffs” screen.
tplFlatDesc: One price per kWh around the clock.
tplTwoZoneDesc: Day and night rates on a schedule.
rebootRequested: Reboot requested — the app will reconnect when the hub is back.
doneBody: The hub is set up and counts by your data. You can change all of this in “Settings” and on the “Tariffs” screen.
rebooting: Rebooting… waiting for the hub to come back.
title: Setup wizard
stepIncomplete: This step isn't finished yet. You can finish it now or continue and come back later.
almostBody: Still to do: {list}. You can return to these steps now or later — from the “Setup wizard” menu.
integrationsBody: The hub can send its data to Home Assistant and other smart-home systems over MQTT. If you don't have one, just press “Skip”. You can set it up any time: “Settings → Home Assistant”.
securityWhy: The token is a password for changing the hub’s settings. Without it anyone on your network (Wi-Fi) can open this app and change settings or the tariff. For a home behind a router that is usually fine — you can skip this step and come back later. The token is kept in this browser; write it down.
